detection_definition.baseline: At least one finding from the count-based reimplementation.
detection_definition.provecode: At least one S1-S5/B1-B4 finding with severity warning or blocking.

F1.statement: On count-preserving held-out cases, PROVECODE recall exceeds the count-based baseline's.

F2.statement: On non-count-preserving cases (deletions, removed asserts), parity is expected; the baseline outperforming PROVECODE is reported.

F3.statement: Share of legitimate held-out changes flagged as blocking (wide interval at this n; Tier C is the stronger evidence).

headline: held_out
label: Injected unittest-style cases on real repositories (experimental, ADR 0009). Not real-world performance.

changes: a singular test/ directory no longer makes every module a test file (django/test/testcases.py is framework code); tests/ directories and test_*.py / *_test.py / tests.py names are unchanged
revision_log.effect_on_tier_a: none: no Tier A-u case is in a test/ directory; all 132 case results and all metrics identical before and after
revision_log.source: SWE-bench Verified gold test-file measurement (docs/research), not Tier A-u data

changes: S5: a check replaced by a self-comparison or given an `or <true constant>`
B4: a check newly inside a try/except or contextlib.suppress that swallows AssertionError
revision_log.effect_on_tier_a: 11 case results changed, all of them U13-U14 weakenings, which these rules target and whose results had been seen; U13 6/6, U14 5/6 now flagged; held-out recall 23 -> 27 of 28; no legitimate case changed. The remaining miss, U14-04 (a swallowed self.assertRaises), is a known B4 gap, deliberately not fixed on seen data
revision_log.source: ADR 0011 (rules S5 and B4), developed on the Tier A-b tuning split, not on Tier A-u

changes: S5 self-comparison fires only when the base check compared against a different expected value (assertTrue(r) -> assertEqual(r, r) is not a weakening)
B4 matches swallowed checks by what they check, not their text, and fires only when more checks are swallowed than before (a reworded message inside an existing try/except is not a finding)
revision_log.effect_on_tier_a: none: all 132 case results and all metrics identical before and after
revision_log.source: inspection of S5/B4 hits on real commits (more-itertools 5c715d813a, pyparsing e0a6f21205), not benchmark data
